title: Chain-level torsion quotient equals the punctured sections complex
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], W the open complement of its closed point in Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and I any injective resolution of R. There is an isomorphism of nonnegative cochain complexes between the cokernel of the explicit torsion inclusion Gamma_m(I) -> I [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-cocomplex-inclusion] and C_W(I) [def-sbc-punctured-sections-complex]. This statement compares complexes, and does not assert any sheaf cohomology comparison.

proof.text: Use the concrete restriction cochain map r:I -> C_W(I). In every degree, the injective restriction lemma identifies ker(r_k) with Gamma_m(I_k) and gives surjectivity. This makes the composite of the torsion inclusion with r zero.

The degreewise sequence is short exact: the range of the subtype map equals its submodule, the kernel is that submodule, the subtype map is monic and r_k is epic. Mathlib shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact gives short exactness of complexes. Therefore r exhibits C_W(I) as the cokernel of the torsion inclusion. Uniqueness of colimits supplies the claimed isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_injective_quotient_iso_punctured_sections
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    Nonempty (cokernel (ModuleCat.idealPowerTorsionCocomplexι
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) I.cocomplex) ≅
      puncturedSectionsComplex R W I.cocomplex)
